evidence: A/empty.png: one-line explanation of what Dogear does, Scan barcode is the only filled button, the goal stepper is preset to 20, and the streak is promised for later rather than faked
A/today.png: 20-segment minute bar and a week chart labelled with a value for every day (Wed 0, Sun half-filled as in progress)
A/book.png: the p.194 highlight is set as serif reading text rather than squeezed
B/today.png: top card reads in order: ring 12/20, then '8 min to go' with the streak chip, then the week chart, then Start Session with 'continue from page 312'; all three books fit above the tab bar

pairs.reason: A's week chart shows each day's minutes and its serif, dog-eared paper style feels like Dogear. B's bars have no values, and its flame-and-orange streak look is generic.

notes: Both have floating tab bars with a separate Search button, glass back and more buttons, and one primary action per screen. B's Today screen is faster to take in at a glance, but its chart relies on bar height against a 20-minute line, and it shows highlights only behind a segmented tab. A leaves the Pillow Book row under the tab bar. B has 2 targets under 44 pt and a failing text measurement on its cover art, which is not primary text.
